# Unit test for function any_int
def test_any_int():
    # Valid cases: one number equals the sum of the other two
    assert any_int(5, 2, 7) == True      # 5 + 2 == 7
    assert any_int(3, 2, 2) == False     # no combination sums correctly
    assert any_int(2, 3, 1) == True      # 2 + 1 == 3
    assert any_int(1, 1, 2) == True      # 1 + 1 == 2
    assert any_int(10, 4, 6) == True     # 4 + 6 == 10
    assert any_int(15, 15, 30) == True   # 15 + 15 == 30

    # Zero and negative integers
    assert any_int(0, 0, 0) == True      # 0 + 0 == 0
    assert any_int(0, 5, 5) == True      # 0 + 5 == 5
    assert any_int(-1, -2, -3) == True   # -1 + -2 == -3
    assert any_int(-1, 5, 4) == True     # -1 + 5 == 4
    assert any_int(-1, -2, 0) == False   # no valid sum

    # Non-integer inputs must return False, even if the sum would match
    assert any_int(3.5, 2, 5) == False   # float as first arg
    assert any_int(2, 3.5, 5) == False   # float as second arg
    assert any_int(2, 3, 5.0) == False   # float as third arg
    assert any_int("2", 3, 5) == False   # string as first arg
    assert any_int(2, "3", 5) == False   # string as second arg
    assert any_int(2, 3, "5") == False   # string as third arg
    assert any_int(None, 1, 1) == False  # None input
    assert any_int([1], 2, 3) == False   # list input
    assert any_int(True, 1, 2) == True   # bool is subclass of int (True == 1)

def test_any_int():

    assert any_int(7, 5, 2) == True      # 5 + 2 == 7 (any position)

    # No pair sums to the third
    assert any_int(3, 2, 2) == False
    assert any_int(1, 1, 1) == False
    assert any_int(10, 4, 5) == False

    # Non-integer inputs always return False
    assert any_int(3.6, -2, 2) == False  # float
    assert any_int(2, 3.6, 5) == False
    assert any_int("3", 2, 1) == False   # string
    assert any_int(3, None, 1) == False  # None
    assert any_int([1], 2, 3) == False   # list

    # Booleans are instances of int in Python
    assert any_int(True, 1, 2) == True   # True + 1 == 2
    assert any_int(True, True, 3) == False
